ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_regret_log_clamped_v2
ir.intuition: Clamped positive delta_regret weights pairs, uses stabilized log-sigmoid loss on score combining log_prob difference and clamped regret, avoiding non-finite values by adding eps inside sigmoid and clamping inputs.
ir.pseudocode:
regret = delta_regret.detach()
pos_regret = relu(regret)
clamped_regret = clamp(pos_regret, 0, max_clip)
score = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * clamped_regret
loss_per_pair = -log(sigmoid(score + epsilon))
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_regret = batch.get('delta_regret', ops.zeros_like(lpw))
    max_clip = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('max_clip', 10.0))
    regret = delta_regret.detach()
    pos_regret = ops.relu(regret)
    clamped_regret = ops.clamp(pos_regret, 0.0, max_clip)
    score = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), clamped_regret)
    # Use logsigmoid for numerical stability instead of log(sigmoid(x + eps))
    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(score))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
